reviews.body: The home was beautiful, spacious, and suitable for a large family gathering, but it was not completely as depicted in the listing. I was initially disappointed by the late 5:00 p.m. check-in time. We had 14 overnight guests, which was within the 15-person limit, yet I was charged an additional fee for my son and my daughter-in-law, who lives in Tempe, to visit our family. I felt this was unreasonable. The home was also not properly stocked for our group. There were not enough bath towels, so we purchased additional towels from Walmart. We also bought pool items to enjoy during our stay. The television in the children’s room did not work. The owners should conduct inventory and maintenance checks before each reservation to ensure everything is functional and adequately supplied. Most importantly, we saw roaches and other bugs in several areas of the home. This property has great potential, but it needs better maintenance, pest control, and attention to detail.

host_response.body:
Thank you, Kerisha, for sharing your feedback. We are glad to hear that you found the property beautiful, spacious, and suitable for a large family gathering. However, we feel it is important to clarify several points, as some statements in this review do not accurately reflect what occurred during your stay or the communication documented through Airbnb.
Regarding the additional guest, your reservation was for 14 guests, while the maximum occupancy of the property is 15 people. However, the family members you mentioned were additional visitors beyond the registered guests, and our house rules clearly state that outside visitors are not permitted without prior authorization. You were informed of the applicable additional guest charge and accepted it. In fact, in one of the messages in the Airbnb conversation, you reacted with a heart to our explanation, indicating that you understood and accepted the arrangement at the time. Therefore, this charge was neither unexpected nor imposed without prior notice.
It is also important to clarify that several of the issues mentioned in this review were not reported to our team during your stay, but rather after or at the time of checkout. This is particularly relevant because our team was available throughout your stay to address any concerns. By not reporting these matters when they occurred, we were not given the opportunity to inspect them, correct them, or send our staff to address them while you were still at the property.
Regarding the television in the children's room, this was an issue that you did report during your stay, and our team followed up on it promptly. The same applies to your other requests, including your request regarding the pool grotto. Our team remained available and followed up on the requests you actually communicated to us throughout your stay.
Regarding the towels and other supplies, we make every effort to ensure that each property is properly prepared and stocked before every guest's arrival. However, if additional towels or other items were needed during your stay, we would have been happy to assist if you had notified us at the time. Since this was not reported to us during the stay, we were not given the opportunity to address it promptly.
As for the presence of insects, the property is located in a warm environment with weather and humidity conditions that can occasionally cause ants or other small insects to appear unexpectedly, even when regular cleaning and pest-control measures are in place. Nevertheless, we take these comments seriously and continue taking the necessary measures to keep the property properly maintained.
Most importantly, throughout your stay, our team promptly addressed the concerns that were actually reported to us and remained available to assist you. For this reason, we regret that the review includes issues that were not reported at the time they allegedly occurred, as this prevented us from having the opportunity to resolve them directly with you.
We are always open to constructive feedback and use it to improve our properties and guest experience. At the same time, we believe reviews should accurately reflect both the condition of the property and the communication and assistance that were actually provided during the reservation.
We appreciate your positive comments about the property and will continue working to provide our guests with a comfortable stay and a well-maintained home.
Best regards,
Carlos Sánchez
Kivoya Reservations Team

I want to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you experienced with the water fountain. We did our best to set it up as requested on both occasions, but we’re grateful you brought this to our attention. We'll take a closer look to understand why it isn’t functioning properly, especially since it’s controlled through a mobile application. We’ll also check the bed you mentioned and make sure everything is in proper condition. Additionally, we'll be more mindful with the linens to ensure we always have enough prepared for our guests. Thanks again for your valuable feedback—it truly helps us improve! Warm regards, Edgar Arias

reviews.title: Great house but very unenjoyable experience with property management company
reviews.body: I have nothing but good things to say about the home. My problem was with the company that manages the rental. After our reservation was made and people were staying in the home for several nights, the rental company contacted me and asked for a photo of my face with my driver license visible in the photo. They also wanted a photo of the credit card used to make the reservation. They told me they had experienced fraud in the past so they wanted to verify my identity. I told them I was uncomfortable meeting these demands because of how those photos could potentially be misused (identity theft) and they told me that if I refused they would have to cancel the remainder of the reservation. I complied because I didn’t have anywhere to send the guests on such short notice, but I will make sure to never rent from this company again.

host_response.body: Hi Kevin, We are sorry to hear that, unfortunately the request about identity verification was for the second reservation you make directly with us, since we do not have the information as VRBO does, we really appreciate the reservation you made with us and hopefully we can see you again, we are willing to offer you a special rate next time reserving directly with us. Regards Alma Rosa
